continuity_scope: Yen On/Yen Press's authorized English light-novel Volume 1 hardback, ISBN 978-1-975359-05-8, released 11 August 2020 (with the same product page also listing a digital edition, ISBN 978-1-975359-06-5). This pass is limited to the official product-page metadata and exact Volume 1 synopsis; no unlicensed or untranscribed novel text is used. Manga, anime, game, audio adaptation, later light-novel volumes, and every other adaptation are separate continuities/witnesses.
work_or_witnesses: Daisuke Aizawa and Touzai, The Eminence in Shadow, Vol. 1 (light novel), authorized English Yen On edition
Yen Press official Volume 1 product page and synopsis
coverage_rule: Include named individual dramatic figures directly named in the exact official Volume 1 synopsis. Cid is the sole named individual. His imagined mastermind role is a stated aspiration/persona, not a separate person node, and the synopsis does not name it Shadow or give Cid a family name. The organization, cult, adversaries, reincarnation, past life, new world, imagination, role-play, and conspiracy premise are dimensional terms or audit context. Its unnamed members and all unnamed adversaries are excluded.
omissions: All persons not named in the selected publisher synopsis, including organization members and adversaries.

Any Japanese-script/romanized family name, alias, codename, organization name, cult name, faction structure, power, skill, artifact, location, reincarnation mechanism, or identity reveal absent from this exact source text.

All detailed Volume 1 scenes and later light-novel material; manga, anime, game, audio adaptation, web publication, promotional artwork, fan wikis, Wikipedia, databases, reviews, and social summaries.
uncertainties: The official English Volume 1 synopsis names the protagonist only as Cid. It supplies neither Japanese script, a surname, nor the word Shadow as a personal alias; no familiar franchise expansion is imported.

The synopsis says Cid is reborn into another world and says he jokingly recruits members to an organization while inventing an evil-cult backstory. It does not state the mechanism, former-life identity, age, gender identity, powers, skills, membership list, organization name, cult name, or any real-world conspiracy claim.

The page has a Teen age rating. Although it refers to an evil cult and imaginary adversaries becoming real, the selected summary does not substantiate a concrete violent act, coercion, injury, death, youth circumstance, or sexual-content event. Deception/role-play is fictional premise material, not safety guidance.
evidence_basis: Official Yen Press/Yen On Volume 1 metadata and synopsis only. The evidence window is deliberately narrower than the full authorized novel and does not mix related manga, anime, game, or audio pages.
